summary: Vested interest under Transfer of Property Act s.19 vs. life interest extinguishment; succession rights under First Settlement Deed (1947) granting property to two sons for life and thereafter to Saroja's line; subsequent invalid Settlement Deeds (1952) extinguishing Saroja's interest; limitation barred plaintiff suit filed in 1993 for Saroja's heir rights after 42 years; adoption validity disputed; adverse possession claim failed; High Court erred in reviving vested interest by treating life interest holders' transactions as incompetent; appeal allowed reinstating dismissal.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment set aside; Trial Court and First Appellate Court decrees restored; suit dismissed.
